info.name: Kreativa LMS Student
info.description:
Student JSON APIs for Postman and React Native.

Auth matches Parents portal mobile Google login (student role only). No email/password.

POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/mobile/auth/google
Body: { "idToken" } OR { "accessToken" } from Google.

Response: tokenType, accessToken, expiresIn, studentId, user.
Test script saves accessToken → {{token}}, plus studentId / userId / schoolId.

Then Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
GET /api/auth/me confirms studentId.

See postman/GOOGLE_SSO.md. Postman OAuth access token can be sent as accessToken (easier than id_token).

Typical errors: 401 Unauthorized / Invalid Google token, 403 ACCOUNT_NOT_REGISTERED, 400 validation, 404 Not found.

GET /api/courses returns { academicYearId, studentId, courses }.

request.description:
Same contract as Parents POST /api/mobile/auth/google, student role only.

Easiest in Postman: OAuth 2.0 Get New Access Token → paste Access Token into {{googleAccessToken}}.
See postman/GOOGLE_SSO.md.

Success: accessToken + studentId. Script copies accessToken to {{token}}.

React Native Google Sign-In usually sends idToken.
Body: { "idToken": "{{idToken}}" }
Alias of POST /api/auth/login (same payload and response as Parents path).
Returns studentId, userId, schoolId, user, and profile.
Clears NextAuth session cookie. JSON { ok: true }.
CSRF token for NextAuth form posts.
ERP-owned Login-As. Redirects and sets cookie. Not for mobile.
Same widgets as the dashboard RSC page, including studentId.
{ academicYearId, studentId, courses[] } for the active academic year.
assignmentId in body must be a number. submissionUrl optional HTTPS URL.

Rapor yang sudah dipublish untuk siswa yang login.
Response: { cards: [{ id, class_name, term_name, term_number, academic_year_name, published_at }] }.
Script menyimpan cards[0].id ke {{reportCardId}}.

Detail rapor SSHS: identitas siswa, subjects (CA/MA/term average), aspects, komentar wali kelas.
404 jika bukan milik siswa atau belum published.

PDF rapor term. Response binary application/pdf (bukan JSON).
Di Postman: Send and Download.
